text:
jo (marketing): Quick sync  planning to announce Adaptive Routing the week of May 18. Need final changelog link, canonical docs URL, a one-line benchmark blurb for the banner, and exact rollout window so we can lock the landing page + webinar. :calendar:

ben (eng): Changelog PR ready: https://git.internal/redwood/changelog/pulls/1307. Small opt-in API: `routing_policy` (defaults unchanged).

maya (docs): I can stage the docs. Please paste the minimal request example and the migration note for pinned models.

ben (eng): Example to include:
```
POST /v1/infer
{ "model": "rwd-adaptive-v1", "routing_policy": { "type": "hybrid", "max_latency_ms": 120 } }
```
Migration note: customers who pin `rwd-standard` keep previous routing; set `routing_policy` to opt in.

tara (sales): Sales needs a hidden landing-page field to tag "interested_canary" and a webhook to auto-create SFDC leads. Can ops handle that?

ops-bot: OPS task created #688 to add webhook + lead tag.

ben (eng): Quick perf summary for marketing (internal): p95 baseline ~128ms -> adaptive ~105ms (~18%); estimated per-token cost -13%. Adding full test details to the changelog PR.

jo (marketing): Great. Webinar planned May 21, 10am PT. Slides: 1 slide bench, 1 slide migration steps, 1 slide rollout/canary. Need a one-sentence banner and a 2-sentence blog intro. Ill draft and post by EOD Wed. Please react with :eyes: when changelog/docs PRs are merged so I can freeze copy.

maya (docs): Staging URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/adaptive-routing (staged). I'll schedule publish at canary start once PR merges.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled #deploy-181234 for 2026-05-20T22:00:00Z. Canary: us-west-2 2% 4h, then 25% ramp if healthy.

ben (eng): Runbook snippet for docs: `canary: { pct:2, dur:4h, checks:[error_rate,p95], rollback_if: {error_rate:0.005, p95_regress:0.2} }`

jo (marketing): Perfect  I'll prep the landing page and social copy. Thanks all — ping here if anything shifts. :thumbsup:
